value.hook: read when woken because a role:<id> send queued with no live holder
value.title: Role-queue wakes come to the PA

sections.name: body
sections.value: s05 went live 2026-11-06 (#129, dc9f2e4). pij send role:<id>[/<instance>] queues when the role has no live holder and wakes the PA (else the prime) with runnable steps; the request drains to the next holder on assign. Assigning is not pa's job: check the role really has no live holder (pij directory), then pass the steps to pm-001 (role:pm-001), or to the prime for the pa/pm/prime roles, in one line. Don't do the queued work. Sends to pm-001 can go to role:pm-001. Verdict requests now go to per-PR instances (reviewer/<pr>, security/<pr>, performance/<pr>). Friction goes to pm-001 as an F-item.
